results.title: Nebius宣布10月1日起全面上调GPU算力及CPU内存服务价格_徽声在线
highlights: 9月17日消息，根据徽声在线从Nebius公司内部获得的最新通知，该企业计划自10月1日起对旗下部分按需GPU算力服务实施价格调整。具体来看，H100型号GPU的每小时租赁费用将从原先的3.85美元提升至4.50美元，涨幅约17%；H200型号则由4.50美元涨至5.40美元，涨幅达20%。B200和B300两款高端GPU的调价幅度更为显著，前者从7.15美元升至8.50美元（涨幅19%），后者从7.85美元涨至9.50美元（涨幅21%）。除GPU算力外，Nebius还宣布对AMD EPYC Genoa系列CPU及其内存服务进行调价，其中CPU价格将上调25%，内存服务价格涨幅约为41%。此次价格调整涉及多款主流计算资源，预计将对依赖云服务的科技企业产生直接影响。

results.title: [新聞] AI折舊論遭打臉？Nebius傳再漲價、連H100也漲租- 看板 Stock - Mo PTT 鄉公所
highlights: 文章標題 請使用 原新聞標題 勿刪減或自創標題，違者4-1處分 原文標題： 請勿刪減或自創標題，違者4-1處分，此行請刪除 AI折舊論遭打臉？Nebius傳再漲價、連H100也漲租 原文連結： 網址超過一行，請用縮網址，連結不能點擊者板規 1-2-2 處分。 https://tinyurl.com/2c7cqf5u 發布時間： 請勿張貼超過3天新聞 2026/09/18 08:34 記者署名： 郭妍希 原文內容： 市場傳出，荷蘭AI基礎建設供應商Nebius Group近期通知客戶，將調高一系列AI晶片的隨需租用價格(on-demand rental prices)， 其中多款輝達(Nvidia Corp.)繪圖處理器(GPU)的租金將上漲約20%。 綜合Barron`s、路透社等外電報導，Futurum Equities首席市場策略師Shay Boloor 17日透過社交平台X指出，Nebius剛剛宣布，自10月1日起調高隨需GPU租用價格，輝達旗下 H100、H200、B200與B300的費率均上漲約20%。 其中，B300漲幅最大，每GPU小時租金將從7.85美元調高至9.50美元。與此同時，Nebius也持續擴大在歐洲與美國的GPU供應量。 另外，根據路透消息，Nebius已是三個月來第二度漲價，傳出的部分漲價細節如下： ‧ 部分輝達GPU的租用費率將調漲17%至21%。 ‧ 部分採用超微(AMD)與英特爾(Intel)中央處理器(CPU)的隨需運算服務，以及記憶體服務價格也將調高。 ‧ Nebius表示，部分純CPU運算執行個體的價格將上漲25%，部分記憶體服務價格則將調高約41%。 ‧ Nebius指出，若客戶預訂大規模運算叢集、租期達數個月，可享有長期承諾折扣。 Nebius此次漲價前，旗下AI雲端業務剛經歷一季快速成長，期間簽下4份客戶合約，每份合約平均金額超過10億美元。Nebius等新型雲端業者(neocloud)主要出租AI模型所需的高效能晶片與資料中心基礎設施。 這波漲價另一個值得注意之處，是Nebius連H100晶片的租用價格也一併調高。H100早在2022年就已推出。 包括電影《大賣空》本尊麥可貝瑞(Michael Burry)在內的AI懷疑論者，過去提出的一項主要論點是，雲端運算公司採用6年折舊年限，因此高估了向輝達採購晶片的長期價值。所謂折舊年限，是將資產成本分攤至預估使用年限的期間；若這項質疑成立，就意味著晶片買家一直系統性低估每年的折舊費用。 如今Nebius有信心調高推出已約4年的晶片租用價格，顯示至少就目前而言，先前的這項質疑可能並不成立。 Nebius 17日聞訊勁揚4.12%、收217.99美元。 其他新型雲端商也同步走強。IREN、TeraWulf、Applied Digital 17日分別勁揚2.02%、7.02%、8.16%。 心得/評論： ※必須填寫滿30正體中文字，心得過短或濫竽充數將以板規 1-2-3 處分 從這個新聞來看 算力過剩論~AI要採煞車的狀況減弱了 看起來現在算力還在嚴重不足 所以才會算力價格繼續漲價

results.title: Nscale Posts $1.02B Net Loss in H1, Nebius GPU Rental Rates Rise Up to 21% | BroadChain.info
highlights:
AI cloud service provider Nebius announced that starting October 1, it will raise on-demand rental prices for some Nvidia GPUs, the second price increase within three months. The price per GPU hour for H100 rose from $3.85 to $4.50, an increase of about 17%; H200 rose from $4.50 to $5.40, an increase of 20%; B200 and B300 rose to $8.50 and $9.50 respectively. This price adjustment also involves some CPU and memory resources. Nebius recently signed four customer contracts averaging more than $1 billion each, and competitor CoreWeave also said prices for newly signed computing power contracts have increased. However, this adjustment targets on-demand quotes for designated regions and models, and long-term reservation customers can still obtain discounts.

 Today's main thread: GPU rental prices are still rising, but the funds needed for computing power expansion are also becoming increasingly massive. Nebius once again raised on-demand quotes, OpenAI expects free cash flow outflow of $278 billion over the next five years, and Oracle-related data center loans are seeing discounts and distribution difficulties. There are still pricing signals on the demand side, but whether projects can obtain funding, be delivered on schedule, and generate revenue will affect subsequent expansion.

results.title: Nebius (NASDAQ: NBIS) Stock Price Hike Signals Surging Demand For AI Compute Capacity
highlights:
Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) shares surged nearly 9% in Thursday premarket trading after the AI cloud provider reportedly raised prices across several compute services.

According to a customer communication circulated online, Nebius plans to increase prices for several on-demand GPU offerings beginning October 1.

The reported changes cover Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) H100, H200, B200, and B300 accelerators, among the most critical chips used for AI training and inference workloads.

Nebius has not publicly confirmed the pricing changes and did not immediately respond to a request for comment at the time of reporting.

The reported increases extend beyond GPU offerings, with pricing adjustments also expected across CPU compute and memory services.

...

Investors appear to be interpreting the reported price increases as a broadly positive signal for the wider neocloud industry, not just for Nebius alone.

Neocloud companies are spending heavily to secure Nvidia GPUs, build data centers, and expand power capacity, making pricing power a central variable in their long-term investment cases.

...

The critical risk remains that the information has not yet been formally confirmed by Nebius, leaving some uncertainty around whether these changes will hold as described.

Investors should watch whether the company verifies the changes, how customers respond, and whether competitors introduce similar pricing moves in the weeks ahead.

results.title: Nebius says it will raise AI cloud rental prices from… | Pivot News
highlights:
The Amsterdam-based neocloud firm's second increase in three months lifts pay-as-you-go rates for selected Nvidia GPUs by 17% to 21%, with memory offerings rising about 41%, though customers reserving large clusters for months can still get commitment discounts.

James Okafor September 19, 2026

Cloud provider Nebius will raise pay-as-you-go prices for leasing selected Nvidia chips starting October 1, the company said on Thursday, September 17, in comments reported by Reuters and carried by Economic Times Tech. It is the company's second price increase in three months. [1]

Rates for selected Nvidia graphics processing units will rise between 17% and 21%, according to the report. On-demand rates for some central processing units made by AMD and Intel, along with memory offerings, are also going up: the company said prices of some CPU-only instances will rise by 25% and memory offerings by about 41%. Customers reserving large-scale clusters for multiple months can receive commitment discounts. [1]

...

The increases follow a quarter of rapid growth in the Amsterdam-based firm's AI cloud business, during which it signed four customer contracts averaging more than $1 billion each. Neocloud companies such as Nebius rent out the high-powered chips and data centre infrastructure used to train and run AI models. Demand for that capacity is surging, per the report, and rival CoreWeave said earlier the same day that it is signing contracts at higher prices. [1]

results.title: Nebius aumentará hasta en un 21 % los precios del alquiler de GPU bajo demanda a partir del 1 de octubre. | Gate News
highlights: Según un informe de Yugin Investment del 22 de Septiembre, Nebius aumentará hasta un 21 % los precios de alquiler de GPU bajo demanda a partir del 1 de Octubre. El analista señaló que el precio de las GPU B300 de Nebius bajo demanda ha subido un 56 % en aproximadamente cinco meses, tras un aumento de precios del 30 % el 1 de Junio. Oracle también renovó contratos de GPU vencidos con tarifas un 20 % más altas, lo que indica una demanda sostenida entre los proveedores de servicios en la nube. Estos aumentos de precios reflejan la intensificación de la competencia entre los modelos de IA, mientras Anthropic estudia lanzar un nuevo modelo antes del GPT-6 Astral de OpenAI, Elon Musk completó el preentrenamiento de Grok 4.8 y Sam Altman anunció varios lanzamientos de nuevos productos para el 29 de Septiembre o alrededor de esa fecha.
